seoTitle: Which Harry Potter Character Are You? Hogwarts Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Harry Potter character test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Harry, Hermione, Ron, Luna, Neville, Draco, Snape or Dumbledore — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Not which house — which character. Are you the brave one who runs towards danger, the brilliant one who's already read the book, or the dreamer who sees what nobody else does? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, rivals and doing the right thing, and find out which Harry Potter character you are.

characters.name: Harry Potter
characters.title: The Reluctant Hero
characters.summary: Brave, loyal and always running towards trouble. You never asked to be special — you just do what's right.
description: Like Harry, you're brave. He faces danger again and again, not because he wants to, but because someone has to.
You're loyal to your friends above everything, and you hate injustice.
You've got a temper and you don't always follow the rules — but your heart is always in the right place.
characters.flaw: You rush in without a plan and try to do everything yourself.
characters.signature: Round glasses, a lightning scar and a Firebolt.
characters.clashReason: they'd break every rule and get away with it

characters.name: Hermione Granger
characters.title: The Brilliant Overachiever
characters.summary: Clever, organised and always prepared. You've read the book — probably twice — and you're usually right.
description: Like Hermione, you're the brightest in the room. She knows the answer before the teacher finishes the question.
You're a planner. Without Hermione, Harry and Ron wouldn't have survived a single year.
You fight for fairness. Hermione even started a campaign for house-elf rights, whether anyone joined or not.
characters.flaw: You can be a know-it-all and struggle when you can't control things.
characters.signature: A heavy book bag, a raised hand and a perfectly cast spell.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you you're doing it wrong

characters.name: Ron Weasley
characters.title: The Loyal Best Friend
characters.summary: Funny, loyal and braver than you give yourself credit for. You'd follow your friends anywhere — while complaining the whole way.
description: Like Ron, you're the best friend anyone could ask for. He's by Harry's side through almost everything.
You're funny and down-to-earth, and you grew up in a big, loud, loving family.
You doubt yourself, but you've got hidden talents — like being brilliant at wizard's chess.
characters.signature: Hand-me-down robes, a pet rat and a strategy for wizard's chess.

characters.name: Luna Lovegood
characters.title: The Dreamy Free Spirit
characters.summary: Kind, strange and completely yourself. You see things other people miss — and you don't care what they think.
description: Like Luna, you're unapologetically unique. Radish earrings, strange creatures and a magazine nobody else reads.
You're calm and kind, even when people are cruel to you.
You see the truth in people. Luna often says exactly what everyone else is afraid to.
characters.flaw: You live in your own world, and some people never get to know you.
characters.signature: Radish earrings, a copy of The Quibbler and a far-away smile.
characters.clashReason: they believe in things you think are nonsense

characters.name: Neville Longbottom
characters.title: The Late-Blooming Hero
characters.summary: Gentle, humble and much braver than anyone expected. You grow into your courage — and then you're unstoppable.
description: Like Neville, you started off shy. He was clumsy, forgetful and underestimated by everyone.
You've got a real talent people overlook. Neville is brilliant at Herbology.
When it counts, you stand up. Neville became one of the bravest people at Hogwarts.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself far too much.
characters.signature: A potted plant and, eventually, the Sword of Gryffindor.
characters.clashReason: they'd stand up to you when you least expect it

characters.name: Draco Malfoy
characters.title: The Proud Rival
characters.summary: Proud, ambitious and sharper than you let on. You act superior — but there's more going on underneath.
description: Like Draco, you're ambitious and a little bit arrogant. He grew up with money, status and a lot of expectations.
You're quick with an insult and you love a rivalry.
But pressure changes you. Draco discovered that the path he was born into wasn't as glorious as he'd been told.
characters.flaw: You care too much about status and what your family thinks.
characters.signature: Slicked-back blond hair and "My father will hear about this."

characters.name: Severus Snape
characters.title: The Misunderstood Enigma
characters.summary: Brilliant, bitter and fiercely private. Nobody really knows you — and your loyalty runs deeper than anyone imagines.
description: Like Snape, you're brilliant and intimidating. He's a Potions master who doesn't suffer fools.
You hold grudges, and you're not warm. People think they've got you figured out — they haven't.
Beneath it all is a loyalty and a love that lasted a lifetime. Always.
characters.flaw: You hold grudges and take out old pain on the wrong people.
characters.signature: Billowing black robes and a single word: "Always."
characters.clashReason: they'd hold a grudge against you forever

characters.name: Albus Dumbledore
characters.title: The Wise Strategist
characters.summary: Wise, calm and always several steps ahead. You believe in second chances — and in keeping a few secrets.
description: Like Dumbledore, you're wise and patient. He's the headmaster of Hogwarts and one of the greatest wizards of all time.
You're kind and a little eccentric, with a fondness for sweets and a twinkle in your eye.
But you keep secrets, and you play a long game that not everyone would agree with.
characters.flaw: You keep secrets from the people who need to know them.
characters.signature: Half-moon spectacles, a long beard and a sweet in his pocket.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep secrets from you for your own good

questions.text: It's your first day at a new school. You...

options.text: Study up on everything before you even walk in
Stick with the first friendly person you meet
Work out who's worth knowing — and who isn't
Realise you've left half your books at home

questions.text: Someone's in danger right in front of you. You...

options.text: Run straight in
Work out the fastest safe solution
Follow your friend in, absolutely terrified
Stay perfectly calm and handle it

questions.text: Someone calls you a name in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Don't mind. You like who you are
Insult them back — better
Take it quietly — then prove them wrong later
Remember it. For decades

questions.text: You've got a free afternoon. You...

options.text: Library. Obviously
Garden. You love growing things
A game of chess — and you win
Wander off on your own and see where you end up

questions.text: Your friend is having a really hard time. You...

options.text: Make them laugh
Say something oddly wise
Stand up for them, even when it's scary
Help from a distance, without them ever knowing

questions.text: Your friend suddenly becomes much more successful than you. You...

options.text: Feel jealous — then hate yourself for it
Be genuinely happy for them. Why wouldn't you be?
Turn it into a rivalry
Resent it quietly. For years

questions.text: You're asked to keep a big secret from people you love. You...

options.text: Say nothing. They're better off not knowing
Keep it — and let them hate you if that's what it takes
Hate it, and tell your best friends anyway
Agree, but plan carefully for when it comes out

questions.text: A rule is standing in the way of doing the right thing. You...

options.text: Break it. Deal with the consequences later
Follow it — and campaign to get it changed
Bend it. Rules are what you make of them
Do what feels right. Rules are just other people's ideas

questions.text: You're treating yourself. You go for...

options.text: Anything fast — a rollercoaster, a go-kart, a motorbike
Something expensive. Only the best
Somewhere dark and quiet, alone with a book
A big bag of sweets. You never grew out of it

questions.text: Your school's new head is covering up a real danger, and punishing anyone who talks about it. You...

options.text: Side with whoever's in charge. It's safer, and there are perks
Join a secret group training to fight back — and work harder than anyone
Play along in public while quietly working against them
Tell people the truth anyway, even if it gets you punished

questions.text: You could go back in time and change one decision — but it might change everything else. You...

options.text: Leave it. Some things have to stay as they are
Only with a very detailed plan
Do it without a second thought if it helps someone you care about
Do it, to fix the one thing you've never forgiven yourself for

questions.text: You find a mysterious, powerful object that nobody else knows about. You...

options.text: Hand it to a teacher you trust. Immediately
Show your best friends straight away
Use it to finally get the respect you deserve
Get very excited. You always knew things like this existed
